# EU Funding News · Ullswater Investments

> Daily, verified news on European funding for innovators, researchers and SMEs: Horizon Europe, EIC, Digital Europe, defence, cohesion funds and Spanish R&D grants, with links to the official sources. Published by Ullswater Investments S.L. (Madrid), EU funding advisors. Every article cites and links an official source.

Key facts:
- Publisher: Ullswater Investments S.L. · https://www.ullswaterinvestments.com
- Contact: eufunding@ullswaterinvestments.com · Madrid: Calle Ramírez de Arellano, 17, 28043 Madrid, Spain · Brussels: Square de Meeûs 37, 1000 Brussels, Belgium
- Languages: English (this site) and Spanish (https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/es/, RSS https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/es/feed.xml). Updated on working days.

## Sections

- [Horizon Europe](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/horizon-europe/): Calls, work programmes and results under Horizon Europe, the EU research and innovation programme.
- [Digital & AI](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/digital-ai/): EU funding for artificial intelligence, data spaces, digital infrastructure and Digital Europe.
- [EIC, Defence & Equity](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/eic-defence/): European Innovation Council, STEP, European Defence Fund and EU equity instruments.
- [Research Policy](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/research-policy/): European Research Area, open science and the rules that shape EU-funded research.
- [EU Budget & Policy](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/budget-policy/): The EU budget, the 2028–2034 MFF, FP10 and the policy behind EU funding.
- [Spain](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/spain/): Spanish R&D and innovation funding: CDTI, AEI, Red.es, ENISA and NextGenerationEU.
- [Climate & Energy](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/climate-energy/): Innovation Fund, LIFE, clean energy and climate funding.
- [Health & Health Data](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/health/): EU4Health, Horizon Europe Health and the European Health Data Space.
- [Dossier: Plan IA360 & Red NEURONA: news and key dates](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/dossier/plan-ia360/): Plan IA360 is the Spanish Government's 12-month roadmap for artificial intelligence, presented on 21 September 2026. It groups 14 projects, from a candidacy for an EU AI gigafactory to Red NEURONA, a network of centres where SMEs can test AI with their own data, and a €600 million AI voucher for companies.

- [European Research and Innovation Days 2026: Day 2 (Auditorium)](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/videos/ri-days-2026-day-2-auditorium/) (2026-11-11): Full stream of the second day in the Auditorium of the Commission's flagship research and innovation event, held in Brussels and online.
- [European Research and Innovation Days 2026: Day 1 (Auditorium)](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/videos/ri-days-2026-day-1-auditorium/) (2026-11-10): Full stream of the opening day in the Auditorium of the Commission's flagship research and innovation event, held in Brussels and online.
- [Horizon Europe Cluster 4 Info Day: Industry & Horizontal Topics](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/videos/horizon-europe-cluster-4-info-day-industry-horizontal/) (2026-10-19): HaDEA's info day on the industry topics of Cluster 4 (Digital, Industry and Space) in the 2026-2027 work programme, plus the application process.
- [Horizon Implementation Day: Finding opportunities and submitting a proposal](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/videos/horizon-implementation-day-finding-opportunities-submitting-proposal/) (2026-09-24): Commission session for newcomers: how Horizon Europe works, how to find calls and partners on the Funding & Tenders Portal and how to submit a proposal.
- [Avoiding the most common financial errors in Horizon Europe projects](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/videos/avoiding-common-financial-errors-horizon-europe-projects/) (2026-09-16): Commission session on preparing for an audit and avoiding the most common and most costly financial errors in Horizon Europe projects.

## Latest articles

- [EU4Health 2026: 11 calls open, with AI and health data topics](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eu4health-2026-calls-11-topics-ai-health-data/) (2026-11-26): HaDEA has published the calls under the EU4Health 2026 work programme: 11 topics, from cardiovascular health to AI in primary care, open until 24 February 2027.
- [EIC STEP Scale Up picks seven firms for up to €113 million in equity](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eic-step-scale-up-seven-companies-113-million/) (2026-11-26): Seven deep tech scale-ups in quantum, aviation, space, energy and health were selected for EIC Fund investments of €10–30 million each, subject to due diligence.
- [€86 million for investment projects in Teruel through the 2026 FITE fund](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/teruel-investment-fund-fite-2026-86-million/) (2026-11-25): Spain approves a €43 million direct grant to Aragon for the Teruel Investment Fund; the regional government matches it.
- [Spanish Chamber of Commerce gets €1 million to manage ERDF and ESF+ programmes](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/spanish-chamber-commerce-erdf-esf-intermediate-body-grant/) (2026-11-25): The direct grant covers the chamber's 2026 costs as an Intermediate Body of EU cohesion funds.
- [€492.2 million zero-interest loan for the SPAINSAT-NG III satellite](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/spainsat-ng-iii-492-million-loan-hisdesat/) (2026-11-25): Spain's Ministry of Industry lends HISDESAT €492.2 million for its new secure communications satellite and reschedules the €808 million loan for SPAINSAT-NG I and II.
- [Spain approves up to €1 billion in state guarantees to renew and decarbonise the merchant fleet](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/spain-state-guarantees-1-billion-merchant-fleet/) (2026-11-25): The guarantees, available until 2029, are part of a Royal Decree-law on transport for 2027.
- [Spain clears €40 million call for job-creating business projects in just transition areas](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/spain-just-transition-40-million-business-call/) (2026-11-25): The Council of Ministers authorises the Just Transition Institute to launch its 2026 call for business projects in areas hit by the closure of coal mines and coal and nuclear power plants.
- [Spain adds €200 million to its FIEM credit line for SME exporters](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/spain-fiem-sme-line-200-million/) (2026-11-25): The Council of Ministers lifts the FIEM line for SMEs and small export and investment projects from €400 million to €600 million, after a record year.
- [Spain backs battery assembly plants for the automotive sector in Valencia and Castile and León](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/spain-battery-assembly-automotive-valencia-castile-leon/) (2026-11-25): Two Royal Decrees give €4 million to the Valencia region and €3 million to Castile and León, which must at least match the amounts.
- [Spain's €600m AI voucher: what it will fund and when it opens](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/spain-ai-voucher-600-million-what-smes-need-to-know/) (2026-11-25): Plan IA360's business AI voucher will fund AI services from European tech firms, not licences. A pilot comes in H1 2027 and the general call before end-2027.
- [Quantum Act proposed, with a path to a Sovereign Tech Equity Fund](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/quantum-act-sovereign-tech-equity-fund/) (2026-11-25): The Commission's Quantum Act sets no fixed budget but lets it create a Sovereign Tech Equity Fund, plus national quantum centres and shared testbeds.
- [Madrid hosts the EIT Health Summit 2026 for the first time](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/madrid-hosts-eit-health-summit-2026/) (2026-11-25): The summit, held on 24 and 25 November, marks ten years of EIT Health, the EU-backed health innovation community.
- [Madrid's 2027 budget raises industrial aid to €44 million](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/madrid-2027-budget-industrial-aid-44-million/) (2026-11-25): The regional draft budget increases industrial aid by 13%, equipment grants for small industrial firms to €19 million and digitalisation aid by 10%.
- [Innovation Fund: ten more IF24 projects sign €477 million in grants](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/innovation-fund-if24-ten-more-projects-477-million/) (2026-11-25): Ten projects from the IF24 reserve list have signed grant agreements with CINEA, bringing the number of funded projects under the 2024 call to 64.
- [Cristina Oyón becomes the first woman to lead the Basque development agency SPRI](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/cristina-oyon-director-general-spri/) (2026-11-25): The Basque Government appoints the head of SPRI's technology and innovation area, who will manage the Transformative Projects of the Euskadi 2030 Industry Plan.
- [CEF Energy: about €750 million for 2026 calls, similar sum for 2027](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/cef-energy-750-million-2026-calls/) (2026-11-25): CINEA's new CEF Energy publication reviews 200+ cross-border actions and points to a similar EU contribution for the 2027 calls.
- [CDTI to act as secretariat of Spain's new commission on technology sovereignty](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/cdti-secretariat-cictiap-technology-sovereignty-commission/) (2026-11-25): Created by Royal Decree-law 40/2026, the CICTIAP commission will first assess up to 20 national interest centres and takes over Spain's Deep Tech Strategy.
- [Castilla y León opens €5.4 million ERDF call for applied-science research](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/castilla-y-leon-erdf-applied-science-research-call/) (2026-11-25): The call funds applied-science research projects starting in 2027 at universities, public research bodies and health research foundations in the region.
- [Basque project Q-CLINIC uses quantum-inspired AI to streamline clinical studies](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/basque-q-clinic-quantum-ai-clinical-studies/) (2026-11-25): Led by Ubikare with Vicomtech and Multiverse Computing, the project is funded by SPRI's Smart Industry – Quantum Technologies 2025 programme.
- [Basque energy agency EVE invests in BiMEP marine energy test site](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/basque-eve-bimep-marine-energy-capital-increase/) (2026-11-25): EVE will put €487,500 into a €650,000 capital increase for the Biscay Marine Energy Platform, with Spain's IDAE covering the rest.
- [Aragon awards €9 million in ERDF funding for municipal waste recycling](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/aragon-erdf-9-million-municipal-waste-recycling/) (2026-11-25): The call drew 59 applications worth €20.9 million; local authorities and waste consortia receive 75% of eligible costs.
- [Spain's State Research Agency opens €10 million call for R&D technical and management staff](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/aei-2026-call-rd-technical-management-staff-10-million/) (2026-11-25): Research bodies, universities, health research institutes and technology centres can apply until 17 December for three-year contracts.
- [Red NEURONA starts in Extremadura with 28 interested companies](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/red-neurona-launches-extremadura-pilot-28-companies/) (2026-11-23): First Vice-President Carlos Cuerpo opened Plan IA360's network of AI demonstration centres in Olivenza; CDTI and ICEX will mentor the companies.
- [Ullswater launches its Funding Assistant, an AI chat for EU calls and Spanish grants](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/ullswater-launches-ai-funding-assistant/) (2026-11-22): The free assistant, now on every Ullswater website, answers questions on 465 open and forthcoming EU calls, more than 150 Spanish State and regional grants, funding news and events, and links each answer to its source.
- [Spain selects bodies for five EU4Health joint actions: 5-day window](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/spain-eu4health-2026-joint-actions-selection/) (2026-11-21): The Spanish Ministry of Health opens a competitive procedure to nominate the Spanish entities that will join five EU4Health joint actions under the 2026 Work Plan.
- [STEP report: almost €24 billion mobilised and 614 Seals awarded](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/step-report-24-billion-614-projects/) (2026-11-19): The second annual STEP report shows €23.9 billion of EU funds mobilised by end-2025, €5.3 billion in direct calls last year and defence added as a fourth sector.
- [EIB Group approves €14 billion, a third for EU energy autonomy](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eib-group-approves-14-billion-energy-autonomy/) (2026-11-19): The EIB and EIF Boards back €14 billion in new financing, with €4.2 billion for clean-energy infrastructure and €3.8 billion for business competitiveness.
- [EDF project D-STORM opens €90,000 cascade call for SMEs](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/edf-d-storm-cascade-funding-call-smes/) (2026-11-18): The European Defence Fund project D-STORM offers up to €10,000 to SMEs and start-ups with operational know-how on loitering munitions and combat drones, until 11 January 2027.
- [Innovation Fund 2026: €5.2 billion in five calls opening 3 December](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/innovation-fund-2026-calls-5-2-billion-info-days/) (2026-11-17): The Commission will launch three grant calls and two auctions under the Innovation Fund on 3 December, with online info days on 9, 10 and 15 December.
- [Horizon Europe opens €297 million digital calls with 12 topics](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/horizon-europe-digital-calls-297-million-ai/) (2026-11-17): Two new Horizon Europe calls under the digital strand cover frontier AI, AI-driven robotics, energy-efficient AI data centres and virtual worlds, open until 18 March 2027.
- [EIC Fund survey: 64% say it was essential to close their round](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eic-fund-survey-64-percent-essential-investment-round/) (2026-11-17): A survey of 182 companies backed by the EIC Fund finds strong support for its role in fundraising, while asking for faster processes and more follow-on capacity.
- [AI Office seeks up to 100 European AI providers for SMEs via EDIHs](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/ai-office-call-european-ai-providers-edih-sme/) (2026-11-17): European AI providers with market-ready solutions can apply until 17 December 2026 to join an 'EDIH Ready' catalogue that Digital Innovation Hubs will offer to SMEs.
- [EIC Accelerator picks 35 deep tech firms for €84 million in grants](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eic-accelerator-35-companies-84-million/) (2026-11-16): Out of 453 full applications, 35 start-ups and SMEs from 17 countries were selected; 32 of them will be assessed for EIC Fund equity of up to €10 million each.
- [EHDS webinar on 25 November: benefits of health data secondary use](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/ehds-webinar-4-secondary-use-health-data/) (2026-11-16): The fourth webinar of the Commission's EHDS stakeholder support series discusses the benefits, challenges and incentives of reusing health data. Open to all.
- [EU launches first global alliance of climate and health funders](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/global-climate-health-research-funders-alliance/) (2026-11-13): Launched at COP 31 with the Wellcome Trust, the initiative will align research funders' priorities. A secretariat starts work in January 2027.
- [ERC Synergy Grants 2026: €500 million for 48 research teams](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/erc-synergy-grants-2026-500-million-48-teams/) (2026-11-12): The European Research Council selected 48 teams out of 957 proposals, a record number of applications, for frontier research projects worth €10.4 million on average.
- [CDTI opens €150 million INNTERCONECTA-STEP call on 17 November](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/cdti-innterconecta-step-2026-150-million/) (2026-11-12): Spain's regional R&D consortia call funds company-led projects in STEP technologies, with at least €10 million reserved for women's health.
- [Australia signs deal to join Horizon Europe's Pillar II](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/australia-signs-horizon-europe-association/) (2026-11-12): Australian organisations will be able to join and lead Pillar II consortia, with transitional access to calls from January 2027.
- [First EDIP Ukraine support call draws 58 defence proposals](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/edip-ukraine-support-call-58-proposals/) (2026-11-11): The €184.5 million USI-IRA call on missiles, ammunition and bombs attracted bids from 11 Member States and Ukraine; results are due in March 2027.
- [MEPs back €200 billion Horizon Europe for 2028–2034](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/meps-back-200-billion-horizon-europe-2028-2034/) (2026-11-10): Parliament's industry and research committee wants €200 billion for the next research programme, above the Commission's €175 billion proposal.
- [Spain's Manza Energía tops first EU energy communities prize](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/energy-communities-governance-prize-winners/) (2026-11-10): Ten citizen-led energy communities from six countries share €1 million in the first EU Prize for Governance Innovations in Energy Communities.
- [EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2026 draws record 1,138 proposals](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eic-pathfinder-challenges-2026-record-1138-proposals/) (2026-11-10): Submissions almost doubled on 2025 for an indicative €96 million budget across three challenges, with results expected in spring 2027.
- [EIT HEI Call 2026: up to €1.25M for university-led deep-tech consortia](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eit-hei-call-2026-universities-deep-tech/) (2026-11-09): The EIT Higher Education Initiative is funding HEI-led consortia that build deep-tech and manufacturing innovation capacity. Deadline: 13 January 2027.
- [EIB alliance channels over €10 billion into European scale-ups](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eib-tech-champions-alliance-10-billion-scale-ups/) (2026-11-09): Fifteen institutional investors and seven Member States join the EIB Group's European Tech Champions alliance, aiming to mobilise up to €80 billion.
- [EU and India conclude talks on India joining Horizon Europe](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/india-horizon-europe-association-concluded/) (2026-11-06): Association is envisaged for January 2027. Indian organisations would then be able to receive funding directly and lead Pillar II collaborative projects.
- [AI Gigafactories call: Lot 1 extended to February, tenders must be resubmitted](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eurohpc-ai-gigafactories-call-deadlines-resubmission/) (2026-11-05): EuroHPC moves the Lot 1 deadline to 4 February 2027, keeps Lot 2 at 3 December 2026 and asks all bidders to recreate and resubmit their tenders.
- [EIC 2027 work programme opens over €1.8 billion for deep tech](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eic-2027-work-programme-1-8-billion/) (2026-11-05): The Commission has adopted the EIC's 2027 plan: €578 million for the Accelerator, €248 million for Pathfinder and €100 million for a defence equity call.
- [EIC sets 19 November info day on its 2027 funding opportunities](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/eic-2027-funding-info-day/) (2026-11-05): The online session will present Work Programme 2027 scheme by scheme, from Pathfinder to STEP Defence. Registration closes on 18 November.
- [CDTI Innovación commits €12.75 million to 19 R&D+I projects](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/cdti-council-19-projects-october/) (2026-11-04): All 19 October approvals are loans. Ten companies get CDTI funding for the first time, 15 are SMEs and 13 operations are co-financed by POPE.
- [Open Research Europe becomes fee-free in 11 countries](https://news.ullswaterinvestments.com/2026/11/open-research-europe-fee-free-11-countries/) (2026-11-03): Researchers in 11 countries can now publish on the Commission's open-access platform without publication fees, under a collective funding model.
